recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Future machine-loadable NamingSystem content for external terminology or identifier systems should be pursued through THO/TSMG governance, not by restoring removed core example bundles.
issue_request: FHIR-6783 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 request to provide the named systems list as a Bundle of NamingSystem resources so implementers could load known code-system and identifier namespaces and connect OIDs to URIs.
initial_application: No source commit explicitly cites FHIR-6783, but commit 6156a02e859af9a1022dd9e52ae7ea8d0e0ffa0a matches the request by removing the named systems ValueSet, introducing better registries, adding identifier-registry.html, and adding source/namingsystem/namingsystem-registry.xml as a Bundle of NamingSystem entries with OID and URI uniqueIds.
additional_context: FHIR-37889 later reached Published/Persuasive with the opposite current-build instruction: remove the Terminology and Identity System NamingSystem bundles because they duplicated authoritative THO content and could mislead stakeholders. Commit 76c99d3aaec99d971f19b9a464838c0c62dbf199 applied that removal, and FHIR-40117 plus commit ededc6fc845f772bb45c2d3b1e4e7b105c2e3d19 confirmed and completed deletion of the remaining empty namingsystem-registry.xml. Current source points external code-system authority to THO and no longer references the registry/terminology bundles in the NamingSystem examples list.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Restoring the old NamingSystem bundle would contradict later final vocabulary decisions and duplicate THO-governed content.

related_jiras.note: Published vocabulary issue that intentionally removed the NamingSystem bundles because THO is authoritative and the bundles could become misleading.
Published technical correction confirming the remaining empty namingsystem-registry.xml should be deleted rather than repopulated.
